meta.note: left and right rendered separately (not mirrored); do not use flipX
meta.feetPivotNote: footprint px relative to the feet pivot (origin), +y down; x,y = top-left

talk.role: play while the dialogue box is open

count_coins.note: Reaches into the purse on his right hip (frames 1-2), holds a stack of gold coins in the left palm and counts three taps with the right hand (coins visible frames 3-8), closes his hands on them (frame 9) and settles. Coins are a hand prop shown only on frames 3-8.

present_goods.note: Showman "behold!": draws in, arms flung wide (2-4), left hand sweeps out palm-up toward the counter to present the wares (5-8, small bow with a planted knee dip on 7-8), back to the clasp.

placement.prop: env_b1_interiors market_stall_base + market_stall_awning (placed at identical x/y, origin (0.5,1.0), per B1 PAIRING.md; assets unchanged)
placement.side: left (open) end of the counter, just outside the left post and clear of the awning
placement.depth: feet 3 px above the stall origin row -> depth-sorts before market_stall_base; awning is overhead but does not overlap him
placement.why: head, shoulders and upper torso stay clear of the produce baskets, posts/braces and awning valance on every frame of every clip (checked in qa_vendor_final.py)

idleVariants.rule: loop idle; after a random 6-14 s pick a variant (both valid in all 4 facings; never the one that just played), play once, return to idle at frame 0, re-roll the timer. Never while talk is playing.

meta.readability: same shirt silhouette rim as npc_bartender final: shirt pixels within 4 px (manhattan) of the transparent exterior use shirt_md
